افتتحتما (form VIII)
# اِفْتَتَحْتُمَا (iftataḥtumā) /if.ta.taħ.tu.maː/: second-person dual past active of اِفْتَتَحَ (iftataḥa)
# اُفْتُتِحْتُمَا (uftutiḥtumā) /uf.tu.tiħ.tu.maː/: second-person dual past passive of اِفْتَتَحَ (iftataḥa)
